Conference Registration

Important Notes:
Conference fees include admission to final abstract uploading, technical sessions, workshops and tutorials, coffee breaks, lunches, welcome receptions, conference banquet and technical tour.
Abstracts without at least one completed and paid registration by Oct. 20 will be removed from the conference program.
A regular conference registration can be used to upload at most 2 contributions. A student conference registration can be used to upload 1 contribution. A new registration is needed, if the upload limit is exceeded.
Cancellation Policy
Refunds will be ONLY made if cancellation occurs before and on Oct. 20, with processing fee.
No refunds will be made after Oct. 20 or for no shows.
In any cases, no refunds will be made if your registration is used to upload your final submission(s) for ICBR 2026.
To cancel your registration, please notify the secretariat by Email: ieee.icbr@gmail.com. And all refunds will be issued within 90 days after the conference.
